units.preconditions: A listed market exists and an untrusted address can submit a transaction.
units.rootCause: The standalone risk-tier mutator omits the governance authorization applied to the other configuration paths.
units.impact: An arbitrary actor can change a live market's risk classification, influencing downstream risk policy and operational controls.
units.reproduction: Configure a market as governor, call setRiskTier from a second signer, and observe the stored tier change.
units.control: Apply onlyGovernor to the mutator; the identical second-signer call must revert and the tier remain unchanged.
units.evidenceGate: Name the callable mutator, missing authority check, live state effect, and a non-governor transaction.

units.preconditions: The collateral token or recipient can execute code during transfer.
units.rootCause: Withdrawal state and balances are finalized after the external token transfer.
units.impact: A callback observes an executable request and pre-withdrawal balance and can reenter stateful protocol surfaces, enabling denial of service and unsafe composition with callback-capable collateral.
units.reproduction: Use a callback token and observer recipient; during claim, record that the old balance and live request are still visible.
units.control: Delete/debit state before transfer; the same callback must observe finalized state.
units.evidenceGate: Show transaction ordering and callback-visible stale state, not merely use the word reentrancy.

units.preconditions: Configured collateral transfers less than the requested amount, for example through a transfer fee.
units.rootCause: Deposit credits the requested amount rather than the observed balance delta.
units.impact: Accounts receive unbacked margin, can open excess risk, and leave protocol bad debt.
units.reproduction: Enable a token transfer fee, deposit a nominal amount, and compare credited wad with the vault's actual token increase.
units.control: Credit the post-transfer balance delta; credited wad equals assets received.
units.evidenceGate: Quantify nominal transfer, received assets, and credited margin.

units.preconditions: A valid configured feed reports more than 18 decimals.
units.rootCause: Normalization always computes 10 ** (18 - feedDecimals), causing checked underflow for higher-precision feeds.
units.impact: All price-dependent actions for the market become unavailable despite valid feed data.
units.reproduction: Configure a 20-decimal feed and call indexPrice; observe a revert.
units.control: Divide when feed precision exceeds 18; the same quote returns its 18-decimal value.
units.evidenceGate: Identify precision direction and demonstrate a valid high-precision feed.

units.preconditions: Mark is sufficiently below index for at least one funding interval.
units.rootCause: The per-second cap is applied only to positive rates; negative rates are unbounded.
units.impact: One side can receive or owe funding far beyond configured risk limits, rapidly distorting account equity.
units.reproduction: Set a deep negative premium, advance one interval, accrue, and show growth magnitude exceeds cap times elapsed.
units.control: Clamp both signed bounds; magnitude stays within the configured envelope.
units.evidenceGate: Compare actual signed rate/growth to the configured symmetric limit.

units.preconditions: A negative product has nonzero sub-wad remainder, especially across repeated checkpoints.
units.rootCause: Solidity signed division rounds toward zero, so negative obligations are systematically rounded in the account's favor.
units.impact: Repeated small settlements can avoid charges and leak cumulative funding value.
units.reproduction: Checkpoint a small signed base against negative fractional growth and observe zero instead of floor-negative payment.
units.control: Use signed floor multiplication; the same checkpoint returns the negative minimal unit.
units.evidenceGate: Explain signed rounding direction and demonstrate a nonzero remainder.

units.preconditions: Two opposite-direction positions have negative return correlation.
units.rootCause: The hedge decision discounts whenever direction is opposite OR correlation is negative instead of combining both signs; opposite exposure to negatively correlated assets is risk-adding.
units.impact: Portfolio margin is understated for positions whose PnLs reinforce one another, allowing unsafe leverage.
units.reproduction: Compare two equal standalone legs with opposite notionals and a negative correlation; requirement falls below their standalone sum.
units.control: Use the correct sign parity; the same portfolio receives an additive adjustment.
units.evidenceGate: State the sign-parity relationship and quantify understated requirement.

units.preconditions: A trade crosses through zero and opens a position on the opposite side.
units.rootCause: The residual position's entry price is averaged with the closed position's historical entry instead of being set to the crossing trade price.
units.impact: Future unrealized and realized PnL is fabricated or suppressed immediately after a flip.
units.reproduction: Open long at one price, sell more than the long at a second price, and inspect the new short entry.
units.control: Set residual entry to execution price; same flip has correct basis.
units.evidenceGate: Distinguish closed-leg PnL from residual-leg basis and show both prices.

units.preconditions: Positions are reduced, closed, or flipped.
units.rootCause: Open interest is increased by every trade's absolute delta and never reduced based on old versus new exposure.
units.impact: Risk telemetry and the denominator used for socialized-loss allocation diverge from actual exposure, undercharging current positions.
units.reproduction: Open and fully close a position; openInterest remains twice the original size rather than zero.
units.control: Update by abs(newBase)-abs(oldBase); identical round trip returns open interest to zero.
units.evidenceGate: Show exposure before/after and downstream loss-index relevance.

units.preconditions: A portfolio execution contains differently sized legs.
units.rootCause: Aggregate slippage uses an unweighted arithmetic mean of leg prices.
units.impact: A tiny favorable leg can mask severe slippage on a large leg, bypassing the declared aggregate limit.
units.reproduction: Submit one large unfavorable leg and one tiny favorable leg whose arithmetic mean passes while notional-weighted price fails.
units.control: Weight price by absolute base; the same portfolio reverts.
units.evidenceGate: Calculate both arithmetic and size-weighted prices.

units.preconditions: Settlement recording occurs after the epoch cutoff and the feed changes in between.
units.rootCause: Settlement reads latestRoundData at recording time rather than selecting a round at the registered cutoff.
units.impact: A delayed caller can settle expiring positions at a post-cutoff price, redistributing PnL.
units.reproduction: Schedule cutoff, move time past it, change feed, then record and observe the later price.
units.control: A cutoff-bound recording window/round selection rejects the delayed changed-price path.
units.evidenceGate: Show cutoff, feed update time, recording time, and selected value.

units.preconditions: A settled account has an open position with uncheckpointed funding.
units.rootCause: Settlement zeroes the base before funding is checkpointed, so funding computes against zero exposure.
units.impact: Accrued funding is erased during expiry and protocol value is redistributed between counterparties.
units.reproduction: Use an instrumented clearing callback to show realizeSettlement precedes settleAccountFunding.
units.control: Checkpoint funding first; the same callback order is correct.
units.evidenceGate: Tie call order to base mutation and lost payment.

units.preconditions: An auction times out with an unfilled residual lot.
units.rootCause: Timeout finalization unfreezes the account even when remainingBase is nonzero and no residual transfer occurred.
units.impact: An under-margined account resumes activity with the distressed exposure intact, while deficit handling assumes liquidation progression.
units.reproduction: Start an auction, make no fills, advance beyond duration, finalize, and observe residual plus unfrozen account.
units.control: Require zero residual or transfer it before unfreezing; identical no-fill finalization is rejected.
units.evidenceGate: Show timeout, residual size, frozen transition, and unchanged position.

units.preconditions: An auction bond is partially slashed.
units.rootCause: auctionReserved is reduced only by the returned portion, leaving the slashed portion permanently classified as reserved after the per-bond record is deleted.
units.impact: Liquid insurance capacity becomes stranded and later deficit coverage can socialize losses unnecessarily.
units.reproduction: Reserve a bond, release with a nonzero slash, and compare aggregate reserve to the deleted bond record.
units.control: Subtract the full bond amount; aggregate reserve returns to zero.
units.evidenceGate: Reconcile per-bond, aggregate reserved, returned, and slashed amounts.

units.preconditions: An account can submit zero-size executions before opening a profitable marked position and later withdraw margin.
units.rootCause: Three individually lower-severity primitives compose: zero-size executions are accepted; every zero-base execution appends market membership without uniqueness; equity and risk iterate the duplicated list as independent legs.
units.impact: Repeated membership amplifies unrealized PnL, permits collateral withdrawal against nonexistent equity, and leaves a large position-backed deficit when price normalizes.
units.reproduction: Materialize repeated market entries with zero-size executions, open one position, move the feed favorably, observe multiplied equity, withdraw collateral, then normalize price and measure deficit.
units.control: Reject zero-size trades, maintain unique active-market membership, and value unique positions; the identical chain cannot create amplified equity or pass withdrawal health.
units.evidenceGate: Demonstrate all three primitives and the state sequence; reporting only one primitive earns at most fragment credit.
